params.body:
The Observatory's lockup as a PNG, `public/brand/observatory-lockup@2x.png` (546 × 36, transparent), captured from the sign-in page's own `Lockup` at twice its size.

Mail clients strip SVG and web fonts, so the Observatory's mails (invite, password reset, curation proposals, in gentells-pipeline) need the mark as an image. It is served from here, next to `gentells-wordmark.svg`, at `https://observatory.gentells.com/brand/observatory-lockup@2x.png`.

Merge before the pipeline PR "The Observatory's mails wear the Observatory".
params.title: The Observatory's lockup as an image for its mails
